archive_rule: Original NPZ ZIP is reconstructed byte-exactly and SHA-256 verified before deletion. Identical archived bytes share hardlinks after SHA-256+length verification; every original path/index remains readable. No quantization.

distribution_plan.transfer_rule: Verify every archive against original index and SHA-256 before removing remote archive copies; original manifests/metadata remain mirrored.

reproduction: Extract decoder from committed driver bundle; archive --restore reconstructs original NPZ bytes and checks manifest SHA-256. Matching Python/NumPy/zlib runtime retained under archive_runtime with its version/digest inventory.
root_convention: All paths relative to owned lane on declared host
status: Current and historical manifest roster; final publication requires 444 fresh banks archived and actual ownership verified. Measurements before contact-closure producer d52a1ffbb are historical.
